title: National AI-Readiness Assessment

author.name: Dr Shyam Sundaram
author.role: Fellow & Lead Technical Architect, iSPIRT DEPA Team
author.bio: Works on consent-based data sharing, confidential computing and AI infrastructure as digital public infrastructure.

bands.name: Foundational
bands.text: Core rails are missing; build DPI before AI at scale.

bands.name: Emerging
bands.text: Rails exist in parts; AI is limited to pilots.

bands.name: Scaling
bands.text: Rails at scale; AI is held back by one or two pillars.

bands.name: AI-ready
bands.text: AI can be deployed at population scale on trusted rails.
